programme.desc: 他重披戰袍，深入首爾權力核心，在外交陷阱與槍林彈雨中，阻止核爆危機聯合國特工 尼爾蕭被派往北韓，阻止恐怖份子企圖引爆核彈並破壞外交高峰會在缺乏支援且被誣陷為兇手的情況下，蕭必須運用高超的潛入技巧與搏擊戰術，單槍匹馬殺出重圍他在致命的跨國密謀中追查真兇，試圖在第三次世界大戰爆發前，捍衛和平並實踐終極的正義

programme.title: 寶萊塢之亂世紅顏
programme.desc: 命運無情捉弄，兩女一男的三角糾纏，一段淒美愛情故事，就此誕生！戰無不勝的巴吉羅，以過人箭術通過考驗，繼任父親馬拉塔帝國首相一職，往後十年間，在他領導下，佔領了半個印度，英勇事蹟傳遍各地這時，允文允武的瑪斯塔妮偽裝士兵，冒死闖入巴吉羅的軍營，希望他能拯救邦德爾坎德在攻防戰場上，瑪斯塔妮為救巴吉羅，身受重傷，巴吉羅的心就此被她所俘虜為了愛，瑪斯塔妮捨棄公主身分，並自貶為妾；為了愛，巴吉羅袒護異教徒的瑪斯塔妮，不但傷害正宮賢妻的心，也面臨政教壓力

programme.title: 終極警探-跨國救援
programme.desc: 猶如本片英文片名死不了的布魯斯威利，將再度施展超級平凡英雄約翰麥克連的渾身絕技，首度走出美國前往充滿異國情調的俄羅斯莫斯科，並在異國遇到與他感情漸行漸遠的兒子傑克麥克連傑寇特尼飾，希望將闖禍的兒子傑克帶回美國的約翰麥克連，意外發現兒子正獨自在當地為美國CIA執行一項重大任務，沒想到惹惱一海票國際恐怖份子，原本就失和而致使意見分歧的他們，必須為此聯手化解一場可能發生的核武危機

programme.title: 戰回敘利亞
programme.desc: 俄羅斯士兵沙貝羅夫在敘利亞擔任排雷工兵，原本應該會一直擔任這份工作到退休，但他在敘利亞遇到了他的此生摯愛，當得知她遭遇危險後沙貝羅夫決定前往沙漠拯救她

programme.title: 龍騎士
programme.desc: 當黑暗降臨，他賭上性命，戰到帝國崩塌！暴君國王為了鞏固永恆王權，下令除去所有龍騎士當最後一顆龍蛋孵化的消息走漏，邪惡巫師佈下天羅地網，四處獵殺身為帝國最後的龍騎士的艾瑞岡，在老騎士教導下，學會與飛龍心靈相通現在，他必須橫越千里尋找反抗軍領袖與精靈公主，試圖集結最後的自由力量，向暴君國王宣戰！

programme.title: 震撼殺戮
programme.desc: 破壞王強尼帶領一支菁英小組，四處掃蕩販毒組織，在縝密戰術背後，卻暗中進行偷款，讓原本常規的行動變了調某日，一名隊員慘遭流彈所傷，兩億偷款行動被迫中斷，只偷藏了一千萬當他們結束行動，前往下水道取款時，卻發現一千萬不翼而飛這時，當局約訪強尼等一行人，試圖找尋一千萬的下落，但尚未尋獲贓款，小組成員卻接二連三被當成獵物般殺害

programme.title: ID4-星際終結者
programme.desc: 當美國準備熱鬧迎接七月四日國慶日之際，突然出現一則疑似從月球發出的訊息電腦工程師大衛試圖解讀外星人來意，但這時外星人卻策動大批艦隊包圍地球，並對幾個重大城市發動攻擊為了抵抗外星人入侵，美國總統親自駕駛戰機衝上前線，決定對外星人展開全面反攻面對史無前例的敵人，面對即將到來的世界末日，美國總統將如何帶領人民共度難關呢？！

programme.title: 悍將女廚
programme.desc: 他們婚姻隱藏秘密，而秘密包藏著致命危機一對老夫少妻經營一家知名餐廳，而妻子安娜是饕客滿座的名廚，然而，她的婚姻裡隱藏著一個不為人知的秘密，直到某晚，一群殺人不眨眼的殺手齊聚於她的餐廳，企圖摧毀她的餐廳，如今，她將如何捍衛她的廚房，施展她不為人知的另一面呢？！

programme.title: The TCUP Show

programme.title: 神木島
programme.desc: 安，一個經常說謊的男孩，跌入了另一個世界在試圖找回原來的世界時，他遇到了危險，這迫使他轉變並逐漸成長憑藉他的富有創意的頭腦，他學會了如何幫助他人在旅途中，他不僅交了很多朋友，還得到了其他人的幫助他能夠在大家的幫助下返回家嗎？

programme.title: 神木島
programme.desc: 安，一個經常說謊的男孩，跌入了另一個世界在試圖找回原來的世界時，他遇到了危險，這迫使他轉變並逐漸成長憑藉他的富有創意的頭腦，他學會了如何幫助他人在旅途中，他不僅交了很多朋友，還得到了其他人的幫助他能夠在大家的幫助下返回家嗎？

programme.title: Kakudan時光機
programme.desc: 透過陸續被發掘出來的文物，如何在重新復原的過程中，去體驗祖先日積月累的文化智慧，並拼湊出祖先的歷史故事呢?透過鑽探調查，如何確認遺址埋藏的深度與分布情形？新手挖掘出來的遺物，如何透過系統化的整理分類後，從無序的地層土壤資料中，結合各界不同學術知識去復原重組呢?

programme.title: 越來越嗖鯊
programme.desc: 越來越嗖鯊！（Xu?t s?c）是公視兒少新住民語言學習節目--越南系列嗖鯊是越南語Xu?t s?c的諧音，也是厲害出色的意思收視觀眾由原本6-12歲的學齡兒童，擴大至家長老師以致於全民節目方向已不只為了要新二代學媽媽的語言，而是要認識台灣多數人的語言主持人-阮秋姮節目中扮演嗖鯊甜點坊老闆，其開朗熱心又有點調皮的個性，成為來店大小顧客解決問題的聊天對象，其和店員嗖鯊哥及來賓，產生有趣的互動，進而瞭解越南語言及文化

programme.title: 愛麗絲的難題
programme.desc: 愛麗絲不小心掉進紅心皇后的王官裡，她必須穿越到人類世界,在3位樸克牌小兵的幫助下一起為紅心皇后解決各種難題,挑戰成功才有機會踏上回家的路這是一個數感知識型節目,透過戲劇角色扮演情境體驗闖關,讓孩子跳脫課本習作的枯燥，在日常生活中感受到數理和邏輯無所不在！

programme.title: Kakudan時光機

programme.desc: 健康好生活從最基本的健康飲食著手，詳細探討人體所需之各大營養素，運用時令的當季食材，做出營養均衡又美味的家常料理！而在節目中的台灣各專科百大名醫，則是透過分享在醫療工作上的實際案例，說明各種疾病的症狀與預防的重要性！

programme.title: 百變智多星
programme.desc: 韓星代表專門戶梁赫群，益智鬼靈精傻妞葉欣眉，兩人合作無間智多星主題短劇爆笑開場超直白訪談笑料不斷字助猜體驗文學之美知識淘汰郎刺激中長智慧決戰168誰能闖關成功拿十萬

programme.title: 富貴門
programme.desc: 沙富來羅嘉良父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來馬國明帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元呂良偉回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心袁詠儀，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

programme.title: 百變智多星
programme.desc: 韓星代表專門戶梁赫群，益智鬼靈精傻妞葉欣眉，兩人合作無間智多星主題短劇爆笑開場超直白訪談笑料不斷字助猜體驗文學之美知識淘汰郎刺激中長智慧決戰168誰能闖關成功拿十萬

programme.title: 金裝四大才子
programme.desc: 唐伯虎張家輝祝枝山歐陽震華文徵明林家棟同為?州三寶，受學於六藝書院，聞名江南樹大招風，寧王義子朱子健郭政鴻招攬來自波斯的奇才周文賓魏俊傑，不擇手段擊倒三人唐伯虎三人揭穿劣行，不記前嫌，施以援手，與周文賓四人結為八拜之交寧王高雄賞識四人才情，引為幕僚，安排四人挖掘瓦片寶藏，而藏寶處極有可能為華太師府，派唐伯虎到太師府充當書僮，易名華安，四大才子分別與秋香關詠荷石榴翁虹朱娉婷陳松伶祝曉蓮文頌嫻各有感情試煉，也捲入寧王謀反正德皇的叛亂中

programme.title: 台灣壹百種味道第1季
programme.desc: 台灣壹百種味道以臺灣味為主角，透過節目，呈現每一道臺灣菜的滋味與廚師的故事 藉由一道道美食，看見每一位美食作手，背後所潛藏的人生故事 觀眾跟著故事了解臺灣美食歷史

programme.desc: 這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！

programme.title: 全民星攻略
programme.desc: 由館長曾國城擔任知識把關者，考驗著每個來挑戰九宮格益智遊戲的藝人明星想要攻略九宮格關卡，透過創意聯想邏輯推理理性分析，才有機會獲取智慧星幣，帶走夢幻大獎

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.title: 桃花映江山
programme.desc: 北苑國公主姜桃花（孟子義 飾）千里迢迢來到大祈和親，卻慘遭設局陷害清白盡毀為了在危機四伏的異國苟活，桃花將錯就錯，嫁給了權傾朝野習慣獨行的冷酷左相沈在野（劉學義 飾），憑著一流的逢場作戲本領與極強的求生欲，展開驚心動魄的生存戰

programme.title: 娘娘腔日記
programme.desc: 超級網紅凱薩琳因意外不慎跌倒而昏迷，眼看著下禮拜的重要拍攝就要開天窗，如果凱薩琳無法到場就要面對五千萬的鉅額賠償就在絕望之際，他們找到了賣咖哩的小南，有著一張極為相似凱薩琳美麗的臉龐，但除了有張漂亮的臉蛋外，卻是個超級土包子！

programme.title: 借來的100天
programme.desc: 一個遊蕩人世的靈魂，意外獲得重生的機會，借屍還魂住進一位泰國高中生小旻的身體展開一段新生活不如表面看起來輕鬆，試著融入新家庭新學校的過程中，也遇見讓人心跳加速的學伴小派然而這一切都是有期限的，他必須在100天查出小旻的神秘死因，屆時如未完成任務，他將魂飛魄散永不超生

programme.title: Sunny我們的青春
programme.desc: 已成為熟女的奈美（篠原涼子 飾）與高中時代好友芹香（板谷由夏 飾）相隔22年再度相遇，卻得知芹香因罹患癌症，生命只剩下一個月，她臨終的心願是找回高中曾經一起組團的SUNNY成員為了幫助芹香完成願望，奈美想盡辦法聯繫上失散多年的好友們，隨著尋找的過程，彼此遺忘多年的青春回憶也再度湧上心頭

programme.title: 分秒幣爭
programme.desc: 以1997年亞洲金融風暴期間韓國向國際貨幣基金組織申請援助而展開的談判為背景，敘述了三個獨立的故事

programme.title: 355-諜影特攻
programme.desc: 當可怕的毀滅性武器落入跨國犯罪組織的手中，CIA探員梅絲決定找來各國的情報組織菁英，組成一支超越國界的間諜團隊355，試圖力挽狂瀾阻止第三次世界大戰發生

programme.title: 緣來大飯店
programme.desc: 講述懷著各自的故事來到埃姆羅斯飯店（Hotel Emross）的人們，以各自的方式製造只屬於自己的緣分的故事

programme.title: 小子難纏-空手道傳奇
programme.desc: 年輕的練武奇才李峰（王班Ben Wang飾演）因為家庭變故被迫從北京遷居紐約雖然他努力試著融入新環境中，但也引來不必要的關注，更因緣際會參加了空手道比賽知道自己仍然欠缺鍛鍊，他的老師韓先生（成龍 飾演）為此尋求丹尼爾拉魯索（Ralph Macchio飾演）的協助透過拉魯索的指導，李峰學習空手道並將之與中國武術融合，與對手展開武術對決

programme.title: 死侍與金鋼狼
programme.desc: 本片是死侍系列加入漫威電影宇宙的第一炮，漫威電影宇宙的第34部電影作品，屬於漫威電影宇宙第五階段，象徵了X戰警正式回歸漫威懷抱，死侍與金鋼狼再續睽別15年兄弟情，也被洛基影集中的時間變異管理局抓入，一如以往惡搞，他依然嘴賤嗆說漫威救世主非他莫屬，勢在改寫漫威電影宇宙

programme.title: 特種部隊-眼鏡蛇的崛起
programme.desc: 英雄對抗恐怖份子以及終極正邪之戰，場景從中亞洲的山脈一直到埃及的大沙漠，然後再從熱鬧的巴黎街頭，一直到北極的冰帽被稱為G.I. JOE的特種部隊，由一群來自世界各地的菁英組成，為了對抗居心叵測的軍火商戴斯卓以及神秘的眼鏡蛇組織，他們使用最先進的情報科技以及軍事裝備，希望能夠及時阻止邪惡組織，避免世界陷入一片混亂

programme.title: 魔蟲禁區
programme.desc: 一名年輕女子自海外回國，因為疫情必須先在飯店進行隔離，這時飯店內卻陸續有人離奇死亡面對四處蔓延的大批怪蟲，以及試圖掩蓋真相的飯店高層，房客們逐漸意識到，他們面對的是超乎想像的怪物

programme.title: 只有我能喜歡妳
programme.desc: 霸氣十足的阿杜，從小就視小他一歲的漂亮小阿姨小琳為心目中的女神，因此在學校中只要誰敢靠近她，他便會想盡各種辦法搞破壞!長大後，在醫院工作的小琳更加美麗動人，她身旁的所有男人更是蠢蠢欲動，讓阿杜決定誓死捍衛他的女神，出盡奇招斬斷所有桃花，究竟阿杜能否成功驅逐這些覬覦小琳美色的臭男生，保護好自己的天菜小阿姨呢?

programme.title: 雙面特務
programme.desc: 在這裡，說謊是人們的第二天性 故事發生在21世紀初，國際情勢爾虞我詐，戰爭隨時一觸即發瑞秋（黛安克魯格 飾）因為優異的天分及語言能力，被以色列特務組織相中，送往伊朗進行臥底，佯裝成無害的英文老師，接近神秘的目標法哈德（凱斯安凡 飾），以了解更多核武計畫的內容然而，就在任務即將宣告終結的關鍵時刻，瑞秋卻離奇失蹤了，除了一通打給搭檔湯瑪士（馬丁費里曼 飾）的神秘電話，什麼也沒留下湯瑪士必須想盡辦法找出瑞秋的下落，還要設法保護組織甚至國家的安全不受到牽連

programme.title: 倒數反擊
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊的湯瑪斯，是一名偷天換日的神鬼大盜，曾連續犯下12家銀行搶案並盜取九百多萬美金，直到他因遇見了安妮後決定金盆洗手，當他向聯邦調查局提出交出所有金錢以換取減刑的交易，卻沒想到遭到警方陷害，遭到天羅地網的追捕的他，必須想辦法反擊，來證明自己的清白

programme.title: 血客聯盟
programme.desc: 姍姆（凱倫吉蘭 飾）的母親史嘉蕾（琳娜海蒂 飾）是隸屬於神祕刺客組織事務所的頭號殺手，但她卻突然拋下年幼的珊姆從此人間蒸發15年後，珊姆也成為事務所旗下的頂尖殺手，然而一次出錯的任務，讓她必須在對事務所保持忠誠或是保護無辜的8歲女孩之間做出抉擇

programme.title: 極樂世界
programme.desc: 西元2154年的地球已遭嚴重污染，被遺棄在地球的人都希望偷渡到另外一個人造空間站Elysium這是一個地球人製造的極樂世界，沒有疾病沒有戰爭，很多有錢人已經移民到那裡 馬克思麥特戴蒙 飾在工廠工作暴露在高量輻射中，生命垂危只剩5日可活，唯有偷渡到Elysium治療，才有機會繼續生存為了獲得偷渡資格，馬克思要幫偷渡蛇頭蜘蛛搶取重要的數位資訊，沒想到奪到的資訊遠超過預期的價值，並遭受到國防部長茱蒂福斯特 飾阻撓以及代號野獸的變態探員沙托卡普利 飾追擊，馬克思前往Elysium是否能實現？生命又能否得到延續？

programme.title: 新解釋-三國志
programme.desc: 距今1800年前，中國大陸處於魏蜀吳三國群雄割據的時代在這亂世中，為重返太平盛世，被後人視為英雄的蜀國武將．劉備崛起，在劉備與各國武將們奔騰的熱血時代，終於發生了赤壁之戰，這是一場魏國80萬大軍對上蜀國與吳國的3萬聯軍的兵力懸殊之戰

programme.title: 鋼鐵擂台
programme.desc: 2020年的拳擊賽改由人類操控的機器人上場代打，查理休傑克曼飾是個被時代淘汰的拳擊手，現在他只能在地下拳擊場操控二手的機器拳擊手比賽，並靠賭金維生但他也因此負債許多，所以為了翻轉地位，他必須要升級和積極地訓練拳擊手，所以他需要更多的資金此時從未謀面的兒子麥斯又突然出現，讓他頭疼不已還好麥斯意外發現被當成廢鐵的舊型機器人，可以承受強力的撞擊，但卻對拳擊打鬥一竅不通 於是，查理決定好好訓練它，並將他的拳擊技巧全教授給亞當，希望可以攜手拿下冠軍他們在地下拳擊場展開一場場的決鬥，並朝著冠軍邁進，就在查理進行對機器人的訓練同時，他與兒子的關係也越來越親密

programme.title: 侏羅紀世界-殞落國度
programme.desc: 延續侏羅紀世界劇情，努布拉島上的侏羅紀世界主題樂園被逃出牢籠的恐龍徹底摧毀，存活下來的各種恐龍在叢林中自生自滅 三年後，島上的休眠火山即將爆發，歐文（克里斯普拉特 飾）和克萊兒（布萊絲達拉斯霍華 飾）展開一項救援行動，率隊前往拯救島上的恐龍，避免恐龍再度滅絕，歐文一心一意想找到他從小養大的迅猛龍?小藍搶救恐龍之際，竟然發掘了一項天大的陰謀，很可能讓全地球陷入自從史前時期以來最可怕的危險處境，他們會如何化解？

programme.title: 私刑教育3
programme.desc: 自從退休之後，勞勃麥考仍舊無法忘記他當年當政府殺手時所做的一切，並且透過逞罰惡勢力的作法，獲得心靈上的慰藉這次當他以為在義大利南部找到歸屬時，發現他的新朋友受到當地黑手黨的威脅，因此決定重拾舊業解救大家

programme.title: 魔比斯
programme.desc: 由奧斯卡得主傑瑞德雷托領軍，飾演一位患有罕見疾病的生物化學博士麥可魔比斯；為治療自己的疾病，並試圖挽救其他遭受相同命運的人，他試圖進行一場絕望的豪賭，並大膽在實驗過程中利用吸血蝙蝠的DNA治療雖說實驗結果在起初看似成功，但最後的結果只是顯示，這一切可能只是帶給他比原有疾病更糟糕的痛苦而已

programme.title: 355-諜影特攻
programme.desc: 當可怕的毀滅性武器落入跨國犯罪組織的手中，CIA探員梅絲決定找來各國的情報組織菁英，組成一支超越國界的間諜團隊355，試圖力挽狂瀾阻止第三次世界大戰發生

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的 IPSS 的女王小Ｓ，睽違六年強勢回歸！以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 夢想街57號-預約你的夢想
programme.desc: 提供最新最即時的新車資訊邀請汽車達人分享試車報告同時幫觀眾做最仔細的車款集評還有專家分享最實用最省錢的愛車維修撇步，甚至將難得一見的限量車改裝車等直接搬到棚內汽車節目，不再只是純座談的方式，而是將更專業更豐富更多元化的內容呈現給觀眾

programme.title: 我的眼裡只有你
programme.desc: 李盈怡（裴盧麗 飾）在丈夫過世後成為單親媽媽，白天在婆家經營30年的老牌牛骨湯店工作，晚上則到超商兼職，為女兒金美莉娜（尹採? 飾）努力存錢即便孤獨悲傷，盈怡也不輕易哭泣，直到遇見泰盛零售家族長孫張慶俊（白成鉉 飾）後，兩人的愛情羅曼史即將展開?

programme.title: 進擊的台灣
programme.desc: 進擊的台灣努力呈現出台灣社會各行各業小人物的故事，透過這些平凡人對生活工作的態度，讓觀眾見證他們不凡的精采人生期望以此高品質又能激勵人心的節目，與台灣民眾共同守護我們的一片淨土

programme.title: 寒單

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記:16
programme.desc: 故事主要圍繞著武當派張翠山與明教殷素素之子張無忌（由曾舜晞飾演）的成長歷程，講述了江湖上各大門派的恩怨情仇，以及張無忌與峨眉派周芷若元朝郡主趙敏之間的複雜愛情糾葛

programme.title: 角頭2-王者再起
programme.desc: 故事描述仁哥（王識賢 飾演）面對曾經的好兄弟，如今卻走味變成最換帖的敵人的劉健（鄒兆龍 飾演）重現江湖，不斷挑起紛爭與衝突，破壞仁哥的忍耐與努力維持的和平看著劉健的事業版圖逐漸擴大，身邊的兄弟為了情義有所犧牲，仁哥終究按耐不住釋放出心中的猛獸，與亦敵亦友的劉健正式開戰，為江湖掀起腥風血雨的廝殺

programme.title: 河神-詭水怪談
programme.desc: 故事講述了天津衛五河撈屍隊的水上警察郭得友與師弟丁卯在酒肉和尚李大愣的慫恿下一同探查三岔河口沉屍案，經歷了魏家墳探鬼樓陰陽河仙指路惡狗村捉妖，最終抓住幕後真兇的故事

programme.title: 同學麥娜絲
programme.desc: 故事圍繞四位從高中就互相認識的中年男子的故事說起電風（鄭人碩飾）添仔（施名帥飾）罐頭（納豆飾）閉結（劉冠廷飾）是打從高中時期就彼此打鬧20多年至今的好朋友，平常沒事就會聚在一起到母校隔壁的泡沫紅茶店打牌哈拉添仔總是會拿出一張和千萬大獎差一個號碼的發票給大家看，並言明他和成功只差一步，誓要當一個名揚國際的大導演罐頭是四人當中最窮困潦倒的一個，他皮包裡塞滿的護身符永遠比鈔票還多

programme.title: 大宋少年志:33
programme.desc: 慶曆年間，北宋貌似繁華安定的景象下暗潮洶湧，周邊各個割據政權的細作潛伏於汴京城內，窺探大宋軍政祕事北宋為免除戰事，維護各民族間的和平與穩定，借祕閣之名，培訓少年暗探經過嚴密的選拔和審查，詭詐聰慧的元仲辛美貌機敏的趙簡從不殺生的小景絕不說謊的王寬不愛交流的薛映喜歡美女的韋衙內六位少年，因為種種原因，或情願或被迫，組成了祕閣第七齋

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 消失於中國歷史的10大暗器之首，清朝血滴子暗殺部隊，唯一終極任務就是取下你的人頭！ 反清復明組織牧人日漸強大，以天狼為其首領的 黃曉明飾嚴重威脅清朝盛世，清朝雍正皇帝與兒子乾隆為剷除此勢力，為此培養以血滴子為兵器的特種暗殺部隊從小即接受專業訓練的部隊精英，擅長操作從未有人見其樣貌的神祕飛天暗器血滴子，此兵器能來無影去無蹤的取人首級而瞬間致死，被殺者往往連自己怎麼死的都不曉得血滴子隊長冷（阮經天飾）奉朝廷之命率領率領陳泰蒲巴甲飾 胡圖高天飾穆森李宇春飾十三井柏然飾布喀周一圍飾阿蘇郭鵬飾共7名高手，執行朝廷反清異己的秘密任務，眼看殺人於無形的血滴子天團即將面對史上最強宿敵，從未失手的他們，卻料想不到陷入腹背受敵的陰謀之中，因而從此改寫清朝的命運

programme.title: 勝者為王
programme.desc: 山雞被三聯幫委以重任，為促成幫會與日本山田組聯盟，他娶五代目草刈一雄的女兒草刈菜菜子為妻，特地從台灣回港送喜帖給浩南包皮等人

programme.title: 老師嫁老大
programme.desc: 李樺（范文芳飾演）決定將她所領導的非法高利貸集團，改造成為一個專業且富有愛心的組織，希望擺脫以往由前任團長領導的風格，並禁止使用暴力 此時早已厭煩母親一再逼婚的李樺，無奈的向一位舞蹈老師兼形象策劃師方先生（李國煌飾演）求婚方先生居然出乎意料的答應李樺的求婚婚後兩人的性格雖然格格不入，卻也漸漸開出一朵愛情的花

programme.title: 滿城盡帶黃金甲
programme.desc: 領兵起義成功登基的皇帝為了鞏固江山，拋下糟糠妻迎娶了皇后皇后希望自己的親生骨肉二皇子能夠取代大皇子成為太子，在檯面下不斷製造叛變機會重陽之時，二皇子揮軍策反，滿城的金色菊花成為起義的象徵

programme.title: 瘋狂的外星人
programme.desc: 號稱銀河系最先進的外星文明試圖和地球建交，然而一連串的誤會導致意外不斷外星使者的太空船墜落中國某城市的世界公園中，由於失去超能力和裝備，它竟被耍猴戲維生的耿浩（黃渤 飾）和酒販大飛（沈騰 飾）當成南美洲的猴子，並訓練起來與此同時，之前和外星人交流失敗的超級大國，正根據外星人留下的訊息，在各國間尋找外星使者

programme.title: 新龍門客棧:32
programme.desc: 明朝後期，內憂外患，東有倭寇侵擾，西有異族覬覦沉迷于煉丹修道的老皇上迫於百官壓力，決定立皇長子賢王為太子，並宣召賢王的岳父鎮守西北的老英王前來參加冊立大典這引起強烈渴求儲君之位的皇四子敬王及其政治盟友東廠大太監曹少欽的不滿，暗中策劃陰謀...

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-異次元的狙擊手
programme.desc: 以635米的高度為傲可以俯瞰東京街景的鈴木塔（Bell Tree Tower）竣工前往參加其開幕儀式的柯南等人，從眺望台上享受著絕美的景色就在此時，一發子彈擊碎了窗戶玻璃，打穿了一個男人的胸膛案件發生於一瞬之間，完全搞不清到底發生了什麼，小蘭與少年偵探團陷入恐慌

programme.title: 亡命機劫
programme.desc: 以全世界客機劫持事件橫行的20世紀70年代為背景，講述1971年一架客機在韓國上空被劫持，機組人員與乘客們在極端狀況下展開殊死搏鬥的故事

programme.title: 瞞天過海
programme.desc: 在東南亞某國，富商闊太喬文娜（張鈞甯 飾）被捲入一宗密室被殺案，警長鄭威（許光漢 飾）索要巨額錢財為其脫罪受害者母親虹姐（惠英紅 飾）和議員之子明浩（尹正 飾）的出現，讓案件變得更加撲朔迷離......

programme.title: 新封神榜-楊戩
programme.desc: 取材自經典神話封神演義，從楊戩被迫封印天眼神通，法力大減開始，他轉而成為一位賞金獵人，然而一名神秘女子婉羅找上楊戩，委託他去追捕一名叫沉香的少年，並尋回法力無邊的寶蓮燈沉香企圖用寶蓮燈的法力劈開華山，拯救被壓在蓮花峰下的母親卻不知此舉將會放出被鎮壓在其中的滅世玄鳥，為天下蒼生帶來毀天滅地的災禍而楊戩為了阻止沉香，意外揭開一樁塵封已久的秘密

programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 愛回家之開心速遞
programme.desc: 世代交替，新一代對舊一代嗤之以鼻，總覺得被別人阻礙著他們的未來同樣地，年長一輩亦擁抱過往成功的經驗，總認為自己永遠是對的故事的軸心家庭熊家，正是世代之爭的投射輕鬆的情節除了呈現社會面貌，也用愛和歡笑拉近兩代之間的距離，讓年輕一輩懂得欣賞昔日的美好，舊一代也能聆聽新世代的聲音

programme.title: 踩過界
programme.desc: 講述失明大律師文申俠（王浩信），因失明而努力練就出超強四感；律師事務所女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝），擁有江湖背景；女法官王勵凡（李佳芯），勇於抗衡司法界的保守文化；私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗），以灰色手法搜證，四人為了公義，縱然踩界也義無反顧！

programme.title: 東坡家事
programme.desc: 一代大文豪蘇東坡（歐陽震華飾），才華洋溢，生性豁達，對亡妻王弗情深義重這份深情，讓寄居於蘇府的王弗堂妹王閏之（萬綺雯飾）對東坡暗生情愫，並多番暗示，惜東坡一直迴避其心意一次，東坡和閏之意外惹怒壽安郡主（李亞男飾），閏之為保東坡仕途，答應郡主下嫁鼓莊公子韓元不知情的東坡以為閏之終於想通，送她出嫁，豈料卻發現韓家暗地裡經營假官交子（偽鈔）勾當，韓太君脅持蘇家眾人，逼閏之跟韓元成親，幸關鍵時刻得秦少游（王浩信飾）相救，少游卻失蹤

programme.title: 平安谷之詭谷傳說
programme.desc: 縱已踏入民初時代，地處一隅的平安谷仍由男權主導，女人地位卑微村長陸金谷思想守舊，與海外歸來的兒子陸水豐，及自小受西方教育的媳婦羅桂思產生不少矛盾金谷一妻三妾，宋鳴鳳顧曼儀田初一等三妾背後各有辛酸遭遇陸家表面風平浪靜，其實金谷有病加上鳴鳳之女被擄等神秘事件接連發生桂思對村中男女不平等感到失望，決要幫助受欺壓的婦女此時，有一股勢力暗中策劃各項反男權行動，令村中的男女角力一發不可收拾！

programme.title: 再見枕邊人
programme.desc: 在香港，一個人失蹤七年，其家屬可申請該人在法律上死亡正當製作公司老闆楊萬森決定放下失蹤七年的妻子顧晴天，和一直扶持自己的紅顏知己朱善美舉行婚禮之際，兒子志騫的生母晴天竟現身眼前！晴天因意外墮崖失憶流落外地，在律師金長勝幫助下，七年後重返香港，打算尋回過往記憶晴天重操故業當上記者，竟查出當年自己的失蹤似是有人加害另邊廂，萬森面對新歡舊愛兩難全，更怕晴天回復記憶，讓事情變得一發不可收拾

programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 東坡家事
programme.desc: 一代大文豪蘇東坡（歐陽震華飾），才華洋溢，生性豁達，對亡妻王弗情深義重這份深情，讓寄居於蘇府的王弗堂妹王閏之（萬綺雯飾）對東坡暗生情愫，並多番暗示，惜東坡一直迴避其心意一次，東坡和閏之意外惹怒壽安郡主（李亞男飾），閏之為保東坡仕途，答應郡主下嫁鼓莊公子韓元不知情的東坡以為閏之終於想通，送她出嫁，豈料卻發現韓家暗地裡經營假官交子（偽鈔）勾當，韓太君脅持蘇家眾人，逼閏之跟韓元成親，幸關鍵時刻得秦少游（王浩信飾）相救，少游卻失蹤

programme.title: 平安谷之詭谷傳說
programme.desc: 縱已踏入民初時代，地處一隅的平安谷仍由男權主導，女人地位卑微村長陸金谷思想守舊，與海外歸來的兒子陸水豐，及自小受西方教育的媳婦羅桂思產生不少矛盾金谷一妻三妾，宋鳴鳳顧曼儀田初一等三妾背後各有辛酸遭遇陸家表面風平浪靜，其實金谷有病加上鳴鳳之女被擄等神秘事件接連發生桂思對村中男女不平等感到失望，決要幫助受欺壓的婦女此時，有一股勢力暗中策劃各項反男權行動，令村中的男女角力一發不可收拾！

programme.title: 愛回家之開心速遞
programme.desc: 世代交替，新一代對舊一代嗤之以鼻，總覺得被別人阻礙著他們的未來同樣地，年長一輩亦擁抱過往成功的經驗，總認為自己永遠是對的故事的軸心家庭熊家，正是世代之爭的投射輕鬆的情節除了呈現社會面貌，也用愛和歡笑拉近兩代之間的距離，讓年輕一輩懂得欣賞昔日的美好，舊一代也能聆聽新世代的聲音

programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 再見枕邊人
programme.desc: 在香港，一個人失蹤七年，其家屬可申請該人在法律上死亡正當製作公司老闆楊萬森決定放下失蹤七年的妻子顧晴天，和一直扶持自己的紅顏知己朱善美舉行婚禮之際，兒子志騫的生母晴天竟現身眼前！晴天因意外墮崖失憶流落外地，在律師金長勝幫助下，七年後重返香港，打算尋回過往記憶晴天重操故業當上記者，竟查出當年自己的失蹤似是有人加害另邊廂，萬森面對新歡舊愛兩難全，更怕晴天回復記憶，讓事情變得一發不可收拾

programme.title: 殭屍道長
programme.desc: 毛小方（林正英飾）帶著徒弟阿帆（容錦昌飾）一生隨路以來宏揚道術，為眾人斬妖除魔，沿路遇上一位女神棍鍾君（苑瓊丹飾）和志同道合的楊飛雲（徐少強飾），豈料鍾君的弟弟鍾邦（王書麒飾）是五世奇人，與千金小姐余碧心（文頌嫻飾）相戀，亦是青梅竹馬，在他們的感情道路上挫折甚多，唯一最大的阻礙就是鍾邦要吃下忘情草才會發揮所有潛能對付更強的妖魔，經多番轉折後才拜毛小方為師，卻因此與姐姐反目

震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women expect of it.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: In Wong Jings first modern drama spiced up by three great kung fu choreographers, stars Ti Lung, Chen Hui Min, Wang Lung Wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu defy death.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of The Little Mermaid are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: After the emperors seal is stolen, The Rat and The Cats squabble for martial arts supremacy is put on hold for a time.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: This Yuan Dynasty tale tells of the Sacred Fire sect, Wu Tang clan, O Meis disciples, a sacred book, and the destruction of Shaolin.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: When the younger of two brothers becomes a villain, tragedy lurks when his elder brother makes it his mission to take him down.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaws Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaires daughter.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: Martial artistic mayhem is added to Dantes Inferno with the bringing together of Alexander Fu, David Chiang and the Five Venoms!

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This abourer and complex adaptation of a popular wuxia novel contains conspiracies, stratagems, and sword fights aplenty.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Legendary director Chang Cheh teams Alexander Fu Sheng and Venoms Lo Meng and Kuo Chue in an exciting tale of a kung fu blacksmith.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: In this wuxia film, two rival swordsmen vie with a power-hungry villain to possess the dangerous Peacock Dart.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Directed by Chang Cheh and starring Ti Lung in his first main role, this drama depicts how two lovers contend with family opposition and an unjust accusation.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the mans fiance.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: In this Brave Archer sequel, Kuo Tsings Alexander Fu Sheng love for Huang Yung Niu Niu is challenged by Ouyang Fung.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: Award-winning director Chang Cheh depicts the struggle of the Shaolin monasteries when the Ching Dynasty sets trap to separate and destroy them.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Go on a courageous quest with Hsiao Feng-ling and her classmate, as they try to capture the lute demon Chin Mo and send him back to the netherworld.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: A hothead Wang Chung is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Daring Sung Dynasty must fight their way out of trap after trap and band together to save the prime minister.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: A grateful convict becomes his prison officers defender after he learns that the officers restaurant has been taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: WE 12
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports teamall for a HK500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty Mission Impossible! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consorts craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brothers death. He meets Dr. Hui becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brothers accident.

programme.title: Its a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his sons failed marriage and Kwais dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money cant buy.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the Eagle Gang, a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world without dreams, a monster wanders through a vanishing dreamworld. A woman who can see its hidden visions ventures deep into its dreams to seek the buried truth.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meows attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meows life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man a couple.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mothers chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their fathers drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: This award-winning film directed, written and starred in by Stephen Chow, depicts the adventure of a wannabe gangster who aspires to join the notorious Axe Gang.

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victims mother and the killers mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the countrys energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended version
programme.desc: In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin wont give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... hes just entered Ragdoll mode!

programme.title: Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the 80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: The Feelings Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels notice that Happy looks and seems different - he is frowning, his smile is upside down, and hes wearing new trainers! When they check in on him, Happy is frustrated, but he cant seem to identify where his frustration is coming from. They turn to Duggee for help, who uses his feeling cards to explain an array of feelings to Happy. All the Squirrels help by relaying their past experi

programme.title: The Days of the Week Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they cant wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and theres a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their us

programme.title: Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Lets play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Mount Rushmore, USA
programme.desc: The Go Jetters have gone to Mount Rushmore, to see the carvings of the Presidents faces in the mountainside, but theres a less presidential face adorning the monument - and it has a moustache! The Go Jetters launch the Vroomster to investigate and soon realize that Glitchs face isnt carved into the mountainside at all, but moulded from mud - this is going to be easy to fix, right?

programme.title: Fig
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its the nicest, kindest, Fig, performing his song, Just Cant Help Being Sweet!

programme.title: Apple
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its Apple. Singing in celebration of her great-great-grandad, Apple Trees, 100th birthday.

programme.title: Da Veggie Code
programme.desc: Supertatos Tato belt gets locked inside a glass case for an exhibition, but Tomato cant remember the code to get it out again, and Supertato needs it back to defeat Evil Pea.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise its not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: The World Record
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. If only we had more Duggees muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea...

programme.title: The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggees infectious laughter, once everyone starts, its so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggees crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

programme.title: Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: Whats that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? Its the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Say Hello
programme.desc: Tinky Winky and Laa-Laa are in Home Dome when the Tubby Phone rings. Its Dipsy and Po calling from the Tubby Mobile to say Hello.

programme.title: Safari Party
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like youve never seen them before!

programme.title: Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dads birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Luckys Dads pie.

programme.title: Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey cant get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The films action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from Nine Yang Scriptures by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the Tsai Li Fu style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mos man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in ti

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end u

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the teams downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: 焚城 Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: 因非法偷运废料引发的一场大火，香港陷入辐射泄漏危机为了应对这场毁灭性的灾难，专家范伟立加入由署理行政长官领导的紧急应变小组一支消防队伍临危受命，深入辐射区，拼尽全力阻止辐射扩散在面对前所未见的浩劫时，他们能否拯救这座城市？.

programme.title: 瞒天过海 The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: 年轻貌美的企业家乔文娜被控为一宗密室杀人案的疑凶，而死者正是她的情夫乔文娜找来一名警察协助她洗脱罪名，调查期间他们揭发另一牵涉乔文娜和她情夫的凶杀案，真相逐渐浮出水面.

programme.title: 阴目侦信 YUM Investigation
programme.desc: 阴目侦信是专门助人解决灵异问题的侦探社当阴目侦信调查恶鬼在一栋旧楼出现的案件时，发现所谓的恶鬼都是由炼鬼师亲自炼成，目的是要恐吓居民以清空楼宇作重建之用阴目侦信的侦探们最后能否找到打败炼鬼师的方法？.

programme.title: 风林火山 Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: 故事发生在被白雪覆盖弥漫超现实氛围的香港，一场爆炸夺去了暗中操控贩毒集团的药业大亨的性命，令整座城市陷入混乱警方束手无策，家族企业濒临崩溃富商的小儿子誓言摧毁这个建立在罪恶之上的商业王国，却同时要面对在逃兄长的阻挠，以及父亲旧部为争夺势力版图而展开的激烈角逐.

programme.title: 不说话的爱 MuMu
programme.desc: 木木是一名开朗的七岁女孩，与失聪的父亲小马一同生活在聋人小区中她是父亲与外界沟通的唯一桥梁然而，当失散多年的母亲突然出现时，他们平静的生活被打扰，木木也被迫进入听人的世界与此同时，小马却遭到犯罪集团的诱骗，意外卷入一个专门利用聋人从事犯罪的陷阱中.

programme.title: 镖人: 风起大漠 Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: 隋乱将至，逃犯镖客刀马受命护送神秘人，自西域大漠远赴长安不料护送对象竟是天字第一号逃犯，引发各方势力围追堵截，荒漠沙海间厮杀不断随着阴谋逐渐浮出水面，刀马被卷入一场牵动天下的朝廷与江湖博弈，在危机四伏的长安路上，展开一场生死难测的血战.

programme.title: 热搜 Trending Topic
programme.desc: 网络媒体主编陈妙发布一篇热爆文章成为热搜后，间接导致一名女孩自杀随后陈妙收到一个求助讯息，并发现事件的真相远非表面所见随着事件的公众舆论迅速改变风向，一场为弱者发声之战正式展开！.

programme.title: 熊猫计划 Panda Plan
programme.desc: 国际功夫巨星 Jackie Chan 受邀认养超人气熊猫幼崽呼呼后，国际犯罪组织悬赏天价企图夺走呼呼Jackie 连手金牌经纪人及熊猫保育员，展开一场惊险的营救行动，对抗坏蛋.

programme.title: 过时.过节 Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: 八年前，一个传统客家家庭在冬至饭局上的一场争吵，令一家人难以原谅彼此，从此未曾一起过节直至八年后，表妹忽然从英国回港，希望促成一场冬至饭局面临瓦解的危局，这饭局或许也是这个家庭修补关系的契机.

programme.title: 第一炉香 Love After Love
programme.desc: 电影由许鞍华导演，改编自张爱玲的首部短篇小说三十年代，年青女学生葛薇龙离乡别背井从上海到香港求学，因生活拮据，求助姑妈代交学费，却被姑妈利用，成为上流社会社交游戏的诱饵当她爱上花花公子乔琪乔时，正是她堕落的开始.

programme.title: 饭戏攻心2 Table for Six 2
programme.desc: 这是饭戏攻心的续集，讲述二哥和三哥在大哥离家之际，计划要结婚最后，他们的婚宴成为一个混乱的战场，婚宴升级为家族斗兽场，造成一场喜上加喜的饭戏！.

programme.title: 我和我的父辈 My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: 电影由四个单元故事组成，分别由吴京章子怡徐峥沈腾执导及主演，以不同中国时代为背景，通过家与国为题，描写几代父辈的奋斗经历，讲述中国人的血脉相连和精神传承，再现中国人努力拼搏的时代记忆.

programme.title: 冲锋车 Two Thumbs Up
programme.desc: 捱过16年铁窗生涯的阿发出狱后，第一时间召集昔日好兄弟，合力将一架小巴改装成冲锋车，准备打劫一辆走私黑钱的运尸车！警员徐安良洞悉了阿发的大计，同时另一群心狠手辣的悍匪要打劫的目标碰巧也是该运尸车.

programme.title: 一出好戏 The Island
programme.desc: 一场突如其来的陨石撞击地球，使一群正值团队建设之旅的员工遇上意外，流落荒岛其中一个小职员马进坚决要逃出险境，因为他刚中了六千万元的彩票，需在九十天内兑奖他最终能成功领奖吗？.

programme.title: 破风 To the Fore
programme.desc: 天才单车手郑知元在队中担任冲线手，由王仇铭与丘田当他的破风手，为他制造冲线机会二人明白破风手即使出色，亦只有冲线手一人能站上冠军台接受掌声一场意外令三人分道扬镳，但一场赛事又让三人重遇 到底谁能划破逆风，成为最终的王者？.

programme.title: 长空之王 Born to Fly
programme.desc: 经过严苛的选拔，雷宇正式成为中国的新一代试飞员在队长张挺带领下，雷宇等优秀飞行员奉命为最新型的战机试飞在高空上，雷宇不断挑战自我极限，一次又一次的试飞，只希望试出最好的战机，让飞行战斗员安全回家.

programme.title: 别叫我赌神 One More Chance
programme.desc: 嗜赌成性的吹水辉因前女友托付，照顾患有自闭症的儿子这段突如其来的父子生活，由混乱至彼此救赎，他逐渐找回自我当发现儿子拥有跑步天赋后，他决心告别过去，陪伴儿子追逐梦想.

programme.title: 蛟龙行动 Operation Hadal
programme.desc: 深海特种部队接获紧急任务，协同潜艇龙鲸号深入大洋，阻止国际势力策动的超级潜艇阴谋海底战场险象环生，面对敌方的重重伏击与火山口密布的极限深渊，龙鲸号在生死边缘展开极限周旋在这片无人知晓的幽闭深海，一场关乎全球命运赌上性命的终极决战正式打响.

programme.title: AUNTY当网红 Follow Aunty La
programme.desc: 经营鱼丸摊的中年妇女阿花，丈夫被网红抢走，生活面临巨变她化悲愤为力量，决定逆袭人生，从素人蜕变成网红，不仅赢得关注与尊重，更重新找到自我价值.

programme.title: 白日之下 In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: 故事改编自真实事件报社接获一宗有关残疾院舍彩桥之家虐待院友的线报，侦查小组为揭露残疾院舍监管问题，派记者晓琪潜入院舍，揭发内里的非人道生活，寻找日光之下的残酷真相.

programme.title: 湄公河行动 Operation Mekong
programme.desc: 经查明，中国船舶所查获的毒品是由毒枭糯卡的手下故意栽赃所致随后，泰国寮国缅甸及中国四国政府迅速成立了联合项目小组，派遣精英缉毒人员深入金三角地区展开调查，并全力追捕涉案罪犯.

programme.title: 看我今天怎么说 Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: 这是一个关于三位年轻人探索自我的故事子信素恩和Alan各自面对不同形式的听障，他们通过手语建立了深厚的情谊，彼此扶持在爱与友谊的牵引下，他们共同踏上一段寻找自我克服挑战的成长之旅.

programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joos life changes when he discovers hes also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；王牌家族沈騰華晨宇關曉彤宋亞軒沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有王牌好友楊迪沙溢唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂！.

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 短劇 Eternal Joy With YouMini drama
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生.

programme.title: 黑月光法則短劇 Princess RevengeMini drama
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身這是一場關於覺醒反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則.

programme.title: 百姓的味道 Peoples Palate
programme.desc: 美食紀錄類真人秀，由謝霆鋒擔任美食尋味官，與嘉賓一起探尋領略各地風土人情壯麗山河，品嘗民間百味；在野趣橫生的自然和充滿煙火氣的城市中，尋覓中國百姓生活，解讀百味人生.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2021 S12 Perfect Match 2021
programme.desc: 非誠勿擾回歸經典規則男嘉賓登場後，將通過愛之請回答愛之再判斷愛之終決選三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的智推女生參與最終決選陳銘黃瀾加盟非誠合夥人，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 一個文學的午後 A Literary Afternoon
programme.desc: 每集精選一篇短篇小說或詩歌散文，由余華蘇童陳明昊魏冰心擔任常駐嘉賓，以溫潤聲線娓娓道來，並邀請學者剖析文本背後的時代印記與人性洞察.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2019 S10 Perfect Match 2019
programme.desc: 非誠勿擾全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在第二現場與女嘉賓隔空對話男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手.

programme.title: 超燃青春的合唱 Voices of Youth
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團燃青團；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程.

programme.title: 說唱夢工廠 Rap Star Dream Maker Repackaged

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

Rahsia tentang identitinya juga terancam dan dia mendapati dirinya berlumba dengan masa dan hati yang remuk. Sofia juga menemui satu rahsia keluarga yang terpendam menyebabkan dia terkejut

Tetapi terlebih dahulu, dia perlu menyelesaikan satu misi terakhir - walaupun itu bermakna dia perlu menguruskan dua tugas paling sukar setakat ini: memburu pengganas paling kejam di dunia dan menjaga anak perempuannya yang remaja buat pertama kali dalam sepuluh tahun, sementara isterinya tiada di bandar.

programme.title: Petualangan Anak Penangkap Hantu

programme.title: Golden Job
programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: The Equalizer S4 EP1
programme.desc: McCall berlumba untuk menyelamatkan pasukan selepas mereka berada dalam bahaya melampau akibat bekas rakan sekerja CIA-nya Michelle Chambers McCall mengetahui kebenaran di sebalik penarikan balik CIA di Venezuela yang membawa kepada kematian salah seorang rakannya.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP18
programme.desc: Ramli dan Mariam menceritakan kepada Cikgu Siti mengenai ibunya Wan Peah. Ramli dan isteri bercadang mengadakan kenduri kesyukuran bagi menyambut kelahiran bayi pertama mereka, dia juga menjemput orang kampung. Imbas kembali Tok Hashim semasa muda, dia bertunang dengan Fatimah tetapi pada masa yang sama bercinta dengan Wan Peah.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mbah Ngai marahkan Afifa kerana mengugut Mak Leha bagi mendapatkan wang kononnya bagi meyembuhkan kakinya yang busuk. Kumpulan Azhar merancang untuk merogol Siti, cucu kepada Pak Samad dengan menggunakan Nasrun. Nasrun menghadiahkan seutas jam, dia juga menawarkan pekerjaan kepada Pak Samad untuk keluar bekerja di luar kawasan supaya Siti tinggal keseorangan. Nasrun bersama kumpulannya berlakon menyampaikan bantuan kepada penduduk kampong, Lisa ternampak Nasrun yang pernah merogolnya 7 tahun lalu. Dr. Caryl masih berlakon sebagai doktor yang baik untuk membantu Mak Habshah dan Bayu, Nasrun Berjaya menculik Siti lalu di bawa kepada kumpulannya untuk dijadikan sebagai mangsa rogol. Namun Siti sempat melarikan diri sebelum dia dirogol

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP13
programme.desc: McCall bergegas mencari Dante apabila dia diculik oleh sepasang anggota polis yang panik yang takut akan tindakan balas, selepas mereka menahan Dante tanpa sebab dan menggunakan kekerasan yang berlebihan sebelum menyedari bahawa dia seorang rakan polis.

programme.title: Kelibat
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mothers chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their fathers drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: Mobster Sing aspires to join the Axe Gang. As he stumbles into a slum ruled by eccentric landlords that are kung fu masters in disguise, his actions cause the gang and the landlords to engage in an explosive kung fu battle

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student murders his classmate, the lives of both families are shattered. As the victims mother and the killers mother uncover the hidden truths and secrets surrounding their sons, they are drawn into vastly different journeys of grief, guilt and emotional torment.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Dailys Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the countrys energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended Version
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?
