programme.title: Sumandak Takes Borneo
programme.desc: Dewi Remaja 2022 winner Tracie and two friends explore Borneos beautyfood, history, culture, nature, and diversitywhile uplifting communities through local social enterprises in this inspiring travelogue.

programme.title: Aroma Malaysia
programme.desc: Aroma Malaysia menampilkan eksplorasi kulinari yang memperkenalkan hidangan tradisional dan tempatan, diperkaya dengan pengalaman pengembaraan merentasi pelbagai destinasi budaya

programme.title: My Health, My Choice
programme.desc: My Health, My Choice explores daily practices, behaviors, and health issues, highlighting factors like attitudes, diet, environment, and relationships, and provides practical solutions.

programme.title: Negeri Yang Hilang Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Datu Dr.Haji Sanib bin Haji Said yang menghabiskan sepanjang hayatnya mengabdi sebagai ilmuwan dan cendekiawan. Biografi beliau menjadi intipati utama dalam mencari negeri Melayu yang hilang di Sarawak.

programme.title: Bridging Borneo
programme.desc: Bridging Borneo is a documentary series that features 6 bridges and the places of interest that it connects to along the Sarawak coastal road network. These bridges span over iconic rivers to bring communities closer, foster economic growth and make travel easier.

programme.title: L TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Jika Fattah
programme.desc: Kehadiran Fattah yang merupakan seorang anak yatim di dalam keluarga Zaidi telah mengubah kehidupan mereka sekeluarga melalui sikap terpuji yang ada di dalam diri Fattah yang menyedarkan Zaidi dan isterinya Intan.

programme.title: Salina
programme.desc: Salina tinggal di sebuah banglo cantik yang mempunyai sejarah misteri. Apabila kejadian aneh dan menakutkan mula berlaku, terutamanya terhadap anak-anaknya, Salina mula menyiasat sejarah banglo itu untuk melindungi mereka. Namun, keadaan menjadi semakin teruk sehingga membawa kepada kematian yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Olimpias Way
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi pop berusia 70 tahun yang pernah menjadi legenda muzik memulakan satu perjalanan merentasi tempat-tempat yang pernah menaikkan namanya. Dia menyewa seorang gadis muda yang pemalu sebagai pemandu, dan bersama-sama mereka melalui perjalanan emosi yang penuh kenangan, perubahan diri, dan hubungan antara dua generasi. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka mula memahami erti kehidupan, kehilangan, dan kebebasan untuk memilih jalan sendiri.

programme.title: Duyung
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jimmy, seorang pemuda kampung yang mencintai alam sekitar dan hidup sederhana di tepi laut. Suatu hari, dia menyelamatkan seekor ikan duyung yang bertukar menjadi gadis jelita bernama Puteri. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidup Jimmy dan mencetuskan pelbagai kejadian lucu serta romantik antara manusia dan duyung.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Surga Di Telapak Kaki Ibu
programme.desc: Kisah Bayu, remaja yang hidup bersama ibunya setelah ayahnya meninggal. Bayu merasa tertekan kerana kemiskinan dan sering menyalahkan ibunya atas nasib mereka. Namun, ketika ibunya jatuh sakit, Bayu mula menyedari kasih sayang dan pengorbanan besar seorang ibu serta pentingnya taat dan berbakti kepadanya.

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: Memory Lane
programme.desc: Kisah pasangan warga emas, Jaap dan Maartje, yang mengembara ke Sepanyol untuk bertemu sahabat lama. Perjalanan tersebut membuka kembali kenangan lama serta membantu mereka menemukan semula makna cinta dan hubungan mereka selepas bertahun bersama.

programme.title: Sifu Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Dilan 1991
programme.desc: Sambungan kisah cinta Dilan dan Milea selepas mereka menjadi pasangan. Hubungan mereka mula diuji apabila Dilan semakin terlibat dengan geng motor dan pergaduhan di sekolah, menyebabkan Milea risau dan hubungan mereka menjadi tegang. Milea terpaksa membuat keputusan yang sukar demi masa depan mereka.

programme.desc: Rizal, seorang bekas banduan yang baru dibebaskan dari penjara. Dengan perasaan yang cekal untuk buktikan dia seorang yang masih berguna kepada masyarakat dia kuatkan semangat untuk pulang ke kampung semula lalu membuka sebuah kedai makan.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Suster El
programme.desc: Kisah seorang gadis yatim piatu bernama Elnara yang tinggal bersama kakaknya, Resti. Demi memenuhi impian Nara untuk menjadi jururawat, Resti bekerja keras. Hingga suatu hari, Resti bertemu dengan seorang lelaki kaya bernama Verdi dan mereka akhirnya menikah. Nara sangat gembira kerana perkahwinan Resti membawa kehidupan yang lebih baik untuk mereka, tetapi kegembiraan Nara berakhir seketika apabila dia menemui sesuatu yang menggoncangkan dunianya dan mengancam untuk memisahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Teror Pengganggu Pengantin Baru
programme.desc: Menjadi pengantin baru seharusnya menjadi permulaan yang bahagia, namun tidak bagi Willy Aditya Zoni. Hana Cerelia Raissa berkelakuan aneh dan sentiasa ketakutan. Willy menganggap Hana hanya berhalusinasi, sehinggalah akhirnya Willy sendiri menyaksikan bahawa gangguan tersebut memang benar.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Di Antara Dua Cinta
programme.desc: Pada hari ulang tahun perkahwinan Shafira dan Rafael yang ke-2, Shafira dikejutkan dengan berita bahawa Rafael telah terlibat dalam satu kemalangan, dan jasadnya tidak ditemui. Beberapa tahun berlalu, Rafael akhirnya disahkan meninggal dunia. Shafira kemudian membuat keputusan untuk berkahwin semula dengan Julian. Namun, di puncak kebahagiaan perkahwinan mereka, Rafael tiba-tiba muncul kembali.

programme.title: DAcademy Asia 6
programme.desc: DAcademy Asia dengan slogan Suara Sejati Asia adalah pertandingan menyanyi dangdut tingkat Asia. Negara berikutnya yang akan bergabung dalam DA Asia 6 adalah Trkiye! Bersiaplah menjadi bintang dangdut terbesar di Asia!

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Musuh Tapi Jadian
programme.desc: Bara Lucky Perdana, seorang jurulatih panjat tebing, berdepan risiko kehilangan pekerjaannya jika gagal melahirkan atlet yang mampu menjuarai kejohanan kebangsaan. Tanpa diduga, dia menemui Raya Angelica Simperler, seorang penghantar barangan yang memiliki bakat luar biasa dalam sukan panjat tebing. Walaupun sering bertelagah, Bara tetap berusaha memujuk Raya untuk menjadi atlet bimbingannya, dan hubungan mereka perlahan-lahan berubah daripada permusuhan kepada bibit-bibit cinta.

Beberapa tahun berlalu, Rafael akhirnya disahkan meninggal dunia. Shafira kemudian membuat keputusan untuk berkahwin semula dengan Julian. Namun, di puncak kebahagiaan perkahwinan mereka, Rafael tiba-tiba muncul kembali.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: DAcademy Asia 6
programme.desc: DAcademy Asia dengan slogan Suara Sejati Asia adalah pertandingan menyanyi dangdut tingkat Asia. Negara berikutnya yang akan bergabung dalam DA Asia 6 adalah Trkiye! Bersiaplah menjadi bintang dangdut terbesar di Asia!

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Musuh Tapi Jadian
programme.desc: Bara Lucky Perdana, seorang jurulatih panjat tebing, berdepan risiko kehilangan pekerjaannya jika gagal melahirkan atlet yang mampu menjuarai kejohanan kebangsaan. Tanpa diduga, dia menemui Raya Angelica Simperler, seorang penghantar barangan yang memiliki bakat luar biasa dalam sukan panjat tebing. Walaupun sering bertelagah, Bara tetap berusaha memujuk Raya untuk menjadi atlet bimbingannya, dan hubungan mereka perlahan-lahan berubah daripada permusuhan kepada bibit-bibit cinta.

programme.title: DAcademy 7 Mega Konser: Around The World
programme.desc: Konsert kolaborasi antarabangsa yang menghimpunkan alumni DAcademy 7, alumni DAcademy dan bintang terkenal Indonesia. Menampilkan gabungan dangdut dan muzik dunia, konsert ini menyajikan kolaborasi unik, drama muzikal serta persembahan pentas yang penuh memukau.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Makan Terooos
programme.desc: Jelajahi kekayaan masakan yang menampilkan rasa autentik. Sertai kami dalam pengembaraan rasa di seluruh Indonesia, hanya di Makan Terooos, di mana setiap hidangan memiliki kisahnya sendiri.

Melody kemudian pergi berjumpa bomoh. Tanpa ragu, Melody meminta agar dia dapat menukar Nada dengan seseorang yang lebih baik dan juga ingin kembali ke masa lalu. Walaupun kesal, bomoh tersebut akhirnya menuruti permintaan Melody dan mula membaca mantera, sehingga Melody terperangkap dalam portal waktu dan dibawa ke masa lalu.

Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian Qiao Xin, a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban lifes hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili Ma Sichao! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other!

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN Lau Dan built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI Koni Lui, is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE Andrea So, often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today
programme.desc: Severe Case Decoded follows a specialized police unit that tackles bizarre cold cases inspired by real-life Hong Kong crimes.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Human desires can drive us to transform ourselves. However, when desires get out of line due to pure greed for money and power, or even fanciful lust, so much so that whimsical imaginings are infinitely exaggerated. And unintentionally, you just fall into the abyss of moral dilemma and commit all kinds of Deadly Sins. Crime Unit, New Territories East investigates successive cases, including Faceless Corpse, Stone Coffin, 100 Million Motive for Murder, Dangerous Game, Dirty Bullet and Terrifying Lover. Perplexing clues and tangled relationships become the foundation of a series of unbelievable mysteries, revealing the baffling dark side of human nature.

A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili Ma Sichao! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other!

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: A warm and relatable lifestyle talk show that explores the daily dynamics between mothers, daughters-in-law, and modern families. Through real stories, lighthearted conversations, and practical tips on relationships, parenting, and home life, the program highlights touching and humorous moments that help viewers navigate family harmony with ease.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The films action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Cat vs Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Heaven Sword And Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from Nine Yang Scriptures by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the Tsai Li Fu style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mos man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: KGF: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mothers wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

programme.desc: A modern Robin Hood switches from stealing to protecting when circumstances make him the reluctant bodyguard of a high-profile client.

programme.title: Mohini
programme.desc: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, an engaged couple, face chaos when Vaishnavi is possessed by a vengeful lookalike, threatening their relationship and future.

programme.title: F3: Fun and Frustration
programme.desc: Venky and Varun, who plan on marrying rich wives, fall into the trap of their own making when they realise the brides they are wooing are not rich but greedy for money.

programme.title: Bayama Irukku
programme.desc: A man rescues four friends and gives them shelter in his home. However, they soon realise that the mans wife is actually a ghost and decide to help him.

programme.desc: A TV journalist goes against the orders of his corrupt and dishonest boss and helps a group of youngsters in their fight against a pesticide factory.

programme.title: 듀얼
programme.desc: quot살인마 VS 추격자, 똑같이 생긴 두 놈을 쫓아라!quot 나와 모든 것이 똑같은 복제인간이 이 세상에 존재한다면? 그리고 그가행하는 연쇄살인의 범인으로 내가 지목된다면? 모든 기억을 잃고 납치와 살인의 누명을 쓴 복제인간 성준 누명을 벗기 위한 유일한 방법은 이 모든 사건의 진범인 또 다른 복제인간 성훈을 잡는 것. 기억을 잃은 복제인간 VS 절대악 연쇄살인마의 숨 막히는 추격전! 하나뿐인 딸 수연을 납치 당한 강력팀 형사 득천은 기억 속 납치범과 똑같이 생긴 성준을 검거하려는 순간 성준과 똑같이 생긴 남자성훈을 보게 되고, 딸의 치료비 제공을 조건으로 득천에 사건 조작을 제안한 욕망에 찬 검사 조혜는 모든 것을 버리고 딸을 찾아 나선 득천을 추격하기 시작하는데... 인간 복제라는 거대한 비밀에 휘말린 득천과 성준, 그리고 이들이 펼치는 절대악 연쇄살인마와의 목숨을 담보로 한 대결은 박진감 넘치는 추격 스릴러 로서, 빠져들 수 밖에 없는 재미를 선사할 것이다.

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 듀얼
programme.desc: quot살인마 VS 추격자, 똑같이 생긴 두 놈을 쫓아라!quot 나와 모든 것이 똑같은 복제인간이 이 세상에 존재한다면? 그리고 그가행하는 연쇄살인의 범인으로 내가 지목된다면? 모든 기억을 잃고 납치와 살인의 누명을 쓴 복제인간 성준 누명을 벗기 위한 유일한 방법은 이 모든 사건의 진범인 또 다른 복제인간 성훈을 잡는 것. 기억을 잃은 복제인간 VS 절대악 연쇄살인마의 숨 막히는 추격전! 하나뿐인 딸 수연을 납치 당한 강력팀 형사 득천은 기억 속 납치범과 똑같이 생긴 성준을 검거하려는 순간 성준과 똑같이 생긴 남자성훈을 보게 되고, 딸의 치료비 제공을 조건으로 득천에 사건 조작을 제안한 욕망에 찬 검사 조혜는 모든 것을 버리고 딸을 찾아 나선 득천을 추격하기 시작하는데... 인간 복제라는 거대한 비밀에 휘말린 득천과 성준, 그리고 이들이 펼치는 절대악 연쇄살인마와의 목숨을 담보로 한 대결은 박진감 넘치는 추격 스릴러 로서, 빠져들 수 밖에 없는 재미를 선사할 것이다.
